newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Polar to invest $120 mln in Pepsi -paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Polar to invest $120 mln in Pepsi -paper.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan brewing and foods group Polar will invest $120 million this year in its joint venture with U.S. soft drinks giant Pespi, financial daily Economia Hoy reported.

The funds will be used to bring on stream three bottling plants throughout central Venezuela, with production rising through 1997 to 50 million cases from current production capacity of some 35 million. Venezuela's market is estimated at 200 million cases.

Polar and Pepsi set up their 70/30 joint venture late last year after Pepsi's long time local bottling partner, Grupo Cisneros Embotelladoras de Venezuela, switched to arch rival Coca Cola in a suprise August move.
